output_list.criticism: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function increases the balance of a user and the total supply of the token without any overflow check, allowing the owner to mint arbitrary large amounts of the token to any user.

The foreignBuy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function increases the balance of an investor and the total supply of the token without any overflow check, allowing the owner to buy arbitrary large amounts of the token for any user.
The Typo Constructor vulnerability is triggered due to a typo in the 'output_list' function, causing it to revert.
